cpu_vs_gem5.note: L2t uses the core's own CPU L2 (graph instruction count x gem5 CPI of the matching kernel), which is in-sample for these kernels by construction, so its error only reflects static vs dynamic instruction count. The leave-one-out row is the honest generalization test.
